`@interface UIProperty`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.core.hook.property` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [UIProperty.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/core/hook/property/UIProperty.java)

Annotation that makes JOID remember a field of a UI on disk, from one run of the application to the next.

## Description

Put it on a field of a [`UI`](/reference/ui/ui/) that is neither `static` nor `final`.
JOID writes the field as JSON when the UI closes, reloads and when the JVM stops, and reads it back before `init()` at the next opening; the file is `property/<class name>.property` in the data folder.

### value

`String value() default ""` 

Key of the field in the file; empty uses the name of the field.
Give a key to keep the saved value when you rename the field.
